name: Viper-GT1 ~Akira-kun to Issho~
original_name: VIPER-GT1～あきらくんといっしょ～
source:
VIPER-GT1, subtitled "Be With Akira", taking place a few months after the story presented in VIPER-GTB's "Rise After", the player fills the role of a new Anne Mitter's employee who attempts to woo the three current waitresses: Akira, Karin, and newcomer Makoto. Many other VIPER characters, both within the Rise series and otherwise, make cameo appearances.

[From [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/gt1.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
translation:
《VIPER-GT1》的副标题是“与明相伴”，故事发生在《VIPER-GTB》“Rise After”篇的数月后。玩家扮演安妮·米特餐厅的一名新员工，设法赢得三位现任女服务生的芳心：本条寺明、花凛，以及新来的真琴。包括“Rise”系列人物在内，许多其他《VIPER》角色也会客串登场。

[译自 [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/products/games/gt1.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
